description: Add, subtract, multiply and divide fractions with simplification.

faqs.a: With Euclid's algorithm: the greatest common divisor of the numerator and denominator is divided out of both.
The denominator must never be zero, and division by a fraction equal to zero is rejected with an error.
faqs.q: What if I enter a zero denominator?

faqs.a: Yes — enter a whole part in the first box, or leave it blank for a pure fraction like 3/4.

howto: Enter both fractions: whole part, numerator and denominator for each.
Pick the operator: add, subtract, multiply or divide.
Press Calculate to see the simplified fraction.
Also see the mixed-number form and the decimal value.
title: Fraction Calculator
